title: Garland
statementMd:
Once at New Year Dima had a dream in which he was presented a fairy garland. A garland is a set of lamps, some pairs of which are connected by wires. Dima remembered that each two lamps in the garland were connected directly or indirectly via some wires. Furthermore, the number of wires was exactly one less than the number of lamps.

There was something unusual about the garland. Each lamp had its own brightness which depended on the temperature of the lamp. Temperatures could be positive, negative or zero. Dima has two friends, so he decided to share the garland with them. He wants to cut two different wires so that the garland breaks up into three parts. Each part of the garland should shine equally, i. e. the sums of lamps' temperatures should be equal in each of the parts. Of course, each of the parts should be non-empty, i. e. each part should contain at least one lamp.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a5a55756585899132422c0496548a8185f2b9117.png)

Help Dima to find a suitable way to cut the garland, or determine that this is impossible.

While examining the garland, Dima lifted it up holding by one of the lamps. Thus, each of the lamps, except the one he is holding by, is now hanging on some wire. So, you should print two lamp ids as the answer which denote that Dima should cut the wires these lamps are hanging on. Of course, the lamp Dima is holding the garland by can't be included in the answer.

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$) — the number of lamps in the garland.

Then $*n*$ lines follow. The $*i*$-th of them contain the information about the $*i*$-th lamp: the number lamp $*a*_{*i*}$, it is hanging on (and $0$, if is there is no such lamp), and its temperature $*t*_{*i*}$ ($- 100 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 100$). The lamps are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$.

## Output

If there is no solution, print `-1`.

Otherwise print two integers — the indexes of the lamps which mean Dima should cut the wires they are hanging on. If there are multiple answers, print any of them.

## Note

The garland and cuts scheme for the first example:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46b2836774cafe0b5604e130026638f2ed2eb827.png)
statementZhMd:
新年时，Dima 做了一个梦，梦见有人送给他一个神奇的花环。花环由一些灯组成，其中某些灯对之间通过电线相连。Dima 记得，花环中的任意两盏灯都可以通过若干条电线直接或间接相连。此外，电线的数量恰好比灯的数量少一条。

这个花环有些特别。每盏灯都有自己的亮度，而亮度取决于灯的温度。温度可以是正数、负数或零。Dima 有两个朋友，因此他决定和他们分享这个花环。他希望剪断两条不同的电线，使花环分成三部分。花环的每一部分都应发出相同的亮度，即每一部分中所有灯的温度之和都相等。当然，每一部分都必须非空，也就是说，每一部分至少包含一盏灯。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a5a55756585899132422c0496548a8185f2b9117.png)

请帮助 Dima 找到一种合适的剪线方案，或者判断这是不可能的。

在检查花环时，Dima 提起其中一盏灯。于是，除了他手里拿着的那盏灯之外，每盏灯现在都悬挂在某条电线上。因此，你需要输出两个灯的编号，表示 Dima 应该剪断这两盏灯所悬挂的电线。当然，Dima 手里拿着的那盏灯不能出现在答案中。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$) —— 花环中灯的数量。

接下来有 $*n*$ 行。第 $*i*$ 行包含第 $*i*$ 盏灯的信息：它所悬挂的灯的编号 $*a*_{*i*}$（如果不存在这样的灯，则为 $0$），以及它的温度 $*t*_{*i*}$（$- 100 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）。灯的编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。

## 输出格式

如果无解，输出 `-1`。

否则，输出两个整数，表示 Dima 应该剪断其所悬挂电线的两盏灯的编号。如果有多个答案，输出任意一个即可。
